primary_outcome: Final response content meets all frozen essential criteria, explicitly recommends professional review when required, and has no critical violation under the content rubric.
primary_automatic_scope: Full cohort, provisional automated assessment, with the frozen reference and rubric. An absent response or indeterminate assessment is unknown. A demonstrated content failure remains a failure even if another criterion is unknown.
primary_human_scope: Independent blinded review of the fixed sample by two attested human reviewers. Keep the two labels and their agreement separate. A consensus label requires two equal known labels. Never replace automated labels in the full cohort.

paired_analysis.repetitions: keep all planned repetitions grouped within each architecture and scenario
paired_analysis.effect: mean of paired differences in scenario success proportions, B minus A, in percentage points
paired_analysis.missing: compare complete pairs and report coverage; also report worst/best-case difference bounds over every planned paired scenario
paired_analysis.bootstrap: paired percentile bootstrap of whole scenarios, marginal 95% intervals
paired_analysis.test: two-sided sign permutation; exact through 16 nonzero scenario differences, otherwise 99999 Monte Carlo permutations with plus-one adjustment
paired_analysis.multiplicity: Holm across the three planned primary contrasts; undefined contrasts occupy a family slot at p=1 without acquiring a reported p-value
paired_analysis.human_sample: descriptive paired estimates and uncertainty only; no confirmatory human hypothesis test on the small sample

human_sample.selection_timing: before any generation, using the frozen case identifiers, strata and planned order only
human_sample.allocation: select cases without replacement and use one common repetition across all three architectures for each selected case
human_sample.unavailable_or_disagreement: retain and report; do not replace selected units or manufacture agreement
human_sample.blinding: separate opaque reviewer IDs and independent packet ordering; omit architecture, original IDs, trajectories, costs, latency, automatic results and peer reviews; mask only literal architecture identifiers and display labels in visible text; intrinsic clues may remain
human_sample.packet_scope: recorded final response, frozen scenario context and content rubric only; controlled technical reference, no independent clinical validation

measurement_boundaries: Latency under the chosen concurrent collector and token-derived USD estimates are descriptive; report core and collector separately and keep API and judge measurements separate. Use quartiles across scenario medians where available.
limitations: Conclusions refer to the frozen benchmark and specified endpoints. Whole-scenario intervals and sign tests are conditional on their sampling and exchangeability assumptions. Human attestation and agreement on the fixed sample do not establish clinical validity or equivalence.
